name: anyone-can-code
description: Native Codex Desktop plugin for non-technical people: plan, build, and verify in plain English. Built from the ground up with Codex official docs — not migrated from other AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Native Codex plugin for non-technical people: plain-English plan → build → verify (Windows).
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code is a native Codex Desktop plugin made by a non-technical person for non-technical people. It helps you describe what you want, make a plan, build, remember decisions, and check work before claiming done. Built from the ground up using Codex official docs and the Codex plugin model — not migrated from Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or any other AI coding agent. Open beta; still improving.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
